practice.title: Practice data
practice.sub: Sample customers, orders, couriers and claims to practise with for the first days. Nothing here reaches a real customer, courier or the ERP.

card.title: Practice mode
card.lead: While it is on, the shop is a practice shop: the sample products are live on the storefront and you can order from them to practise. Everything is marked Practice and nothing leaves the system: no courier booking, no messages, no ads feed, no ERP, no real money or stock.
card.guard: Owner only · Turn off hides every practice product and record from the shop, lists and reports, it does not remove them. Turn on shows them again.

practice.kept: Products you uploaded yourself ({n}) are never removed by a reset.

reset.title: Reset practice data
reset.lead: Removes every practice record, picture and sample product and leaves a clean store. Real orders, customers and the products you uploaded stay. The PIN alone confirms it.
reset.backup: Take a backup first if you are not sure (Settings › System › Backups).

practice.ownerOnly: Only the owner can use this page.

errors.OWNER_ONLY: Only the owner can do this.
errors.RESET_HIDDEN: Reset is switched off for this shop.
errors.PIN_NOT_SET: The owner has not set a PIN yet.
errors.PIN_LOCKED: Too many wrong tries. Wait a while.
errors.MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE: Picture storage is not available now. Try again later.
errors.NO_SAMPLE_PRODUCTS: There are no sample products yet. Add sample data first.

photos.none: Add sample data first; then the sample products can get pictures.
photos.progress: {done} of {total} products done. Press again to continue if you close this page.
photos.complete: All {total} sample products have their pictures.
photos.note: Each sample product gets a front, back, detail and on-model picture. They stay inside the practice area and a reset removes them.
